face_landmarker.description: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker (float16, 478 landmarks) — downloaded on demand into the verified user model cache and used by detection.py.

selfie_segmenter.description: MediaPipe Selfie Segmenter (TFLite) — downloaded on demand into the verified user model cache for person/hair segmentation.

pose_landmarker_full.description: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Full (float16) — verified on demand for body reshape.

resnet18_bisenet.description: BiSeNet face-parsing model (ResNet-18 backbone, ONNX) — not shipped in the wheel and has no controlled download URL; landmark-only masks are used until a release artifact is supplied.

retinaface_mv1.description: RetinaFace MobileNetV1 (ONNX) — not shipped in the wheel and has no controlled download URL; the maintained detector path remains the capability reported by detection.py.

lama_inpaint.description: LaMa large-region inpainting model (ONNX) — not bundled. Advanced Retouch reports the Telea fallback until a verified model and controlled release URL are supplied.

sr_real_esrgan.description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus super-resolution model (ONNX) — not bundled. AIEnhancer.super_resolve uses standard Lanczos resize and reports that AI SR is unavailable until a verified model and controlled release URL are supplied.

denoise_nafnet.description: NAFNet-SIDD-width32 denoise model (ONNX, opset 17, dynamic H/W, RGB [0,1] NCHW) — not shipped in the wheel and has no controlled download URL; denoise reports the unavailable model instead of claiming a bundle.
